name: B10-0345/2026 (S&D, Verts/ALE) – Ongoing persecution of Christians in Nigeria, notably the Kawel village massacre
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the ongoing persecution of Christians in Nigeria, notably the Kawel village massacre
part_text:
The European Parliament condemns an armed attack in June 2026 on the Christian community of Kawel village in Plateau State, Nigeria, where dozens died. It says the wider Middle Belt conflict is driven by fights over land and water, made worse by climate change, and exploited by armed groups. It calls on Nigeria to investigate the massacre, protect civilians better, share early warnings and fix land policy. It also asks the European Union to push mediation and send more humanitarian aid.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament asks Nigeria and the European Union to act; it does not make law.
- **Who it affects:** Nigeria's government, people in the Middle Belt, and European Union aid and mediation efforts.
- **What happens next:** Parliament sends the text to Nigeria's government and parliament, the African Union and European Union bodies.
